Spark Easy Electrical Pty Ltd is a Sydney-based business specialising in solar panel installation, ducted air conditioning installation, and roof installation and restoration. The company is seeking an experienced Roof Tiler to support its roofing operations by installing, repairing and maintaining tiled roofing systems while ensuring high standards of workmanship and workplace safety. 

The successful applicant will be responsible for installing, repairing and maintaining tiled roofing systems while ensuring all work complies with Australian building standards and workplace safety requirements. This role is essential to maintaining the company's reputation for delivering high-quality roofing solutions and exceptional customer service. 

Minimum Requirements

-	Certificate III in Roof Tiling or an equivalent AQF qualification. 
-	At least two years of relevant full-time experience as a Roof Tiler. 
-	Demonstrated experience installing, repairing and restoring tiled roofs. 
-	Ability to safely work at heights and interpret roofing plans and specifications. 
-	Current White Card and a valid driver's licence. 

What you will be responsible for

-	Studying drawings, specifications and work sites to determine roofing materials and installation methods. 
-	Erecting ladders, scaffolding and fall-protection equipment in accordance with workplace safety requirements. 
-	Installing roofing underlay and securing waterproof sheets over eaves to protect roof structures. 
-	Aligning and fixing starter rows of roof tiles and laying successive rows to achieve correct alignment and weatherproof performance. 
-	Measuring, marking and cutting roof tiles to fit accurately around chimneys, valleys, skylights, vents, ridges and roof penetrations. 
-	Installing ridge and edge tiles using appropriate bedding mortar and pointing materials. 
-	Installing flashing and sealing roof penetrations to prevent water ingress. 
-	Inspecting roofs to identify damaged or defective tiles and carrying out repair and restoration work where required. 
-	Re-roofing existing buildings by removing damaged roofing materials and installing new tiled roofing systems. 
-	Applying sealants and flashing exposed nail heads and roof junctions to ensure long-term waterproofing. 
-	Maintaining roofing tools, equipment and materials in a safe and serviceable condition. 
-	Working collaboratively with supervisors and other construction trades to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently and to specification. 
-	Ensuring all roofing work complies with Australian Standards, building regulations and workplace health and safety requirements. 

Skills, Experience and Attributes

-	Strong knowledge of roof tiling systems, roofing materials and installation techniques.

-	Strong problem-solving and organisational skills. 
-	Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
-	Physically fit and capable of working safely at heights. 
-	Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements. 

The Successful Applicant

You will be required to work on residential and commercial roofing projects across Sydney. The position involves working outdoors in varying weather conditions, meeting project deadlines and maintaining high standards of workmanship and safety. You must demonstrate reliability, a strong work ethic, and the ability to communicate effectively with supervisors, clients and fellow tradespeople.
